description: inbox.ack is the visibility write a PERSON performs: the params name only the key of an item currently needing attention, the actor is the peer the socket authenticated (never a param), and the answer carries the item as it now reads — hidden from the default view yet still COUNTED in inbox.summary, because hiding is a view and not a fact (SV3). The row is append-only; undoing is a new row, never an edit.

door.sentence: Answer with `aeon answer refactor-auth <one of: approve | deny>` or in the app.
